units.topics: Origin of Public Finance, Meaning, Nature & Scope, Private Finance vs. Public Finance, Importance and Role, Principle of Maximum Social Advantage (Dalton, Musgrave).

units.title: Foreign Capital and Economics Development
units.topics: Foreign Capital: Concept, Types, Merits and Demerits, FDI & FII in India, Foreign Debt, Role of IMF, World Bank, and Asian Development Bank in India's Economic Development.

units.title: Budget
units.topics: Meaning, Revenue and Capital Budget, Surplus, Deficit and Balanced Budget, Preparation of Indian Central Budget, Deficit concepts (Revenue, Fiscal, Primary Deficit), Gender Budgeting, Zero Base Budgeting.

units.title: Taxation
units.topics: Meaning and Characteristics of Tax, Impact, Incidence and Shifting of Tax, Indian Tax Structure, Features & Defects of Indian Tax System, GST evolution, merits and demerits.

units.topics: Nature and scope of agricultural economics, Role of agriculture in economic development, Land reforms, Farm size and productivity relationship in India.

units.topics: Calculating Human Development Index (HDI), Multi-dimensional Poverty Index (MPI), Interstate comparisons of human development indicators in India.
